name: Blush Me! Frog
source:
There exists a small village, led by "Madam Mother". She has only one descendant: Her daughter "Lady Me".

Madam Mother wants to find a husband for "Lady Me", and insists that her new husband must be an incredibly handsome frog!!

The romantic (funny?) story begins.... 

[Edited from [url=https://whichcraft.itch.io/blush-me-frog]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有一个小村庄，由“母亲女士”领导。她只有一个后代：她的女儿“Lady Me”。

妈妈妈妈要给“Lady Me”找个老公，并且坚持要她的新老公一定是一只非常帅的青蛙！！

浪漫（有趣？）的故事开始了…… 

[编辑自[url=https://whichcraft.itch.io/blush-me-frog]itch.io[/url]]
